verdict.rationale: The Kimi API Platform documents organization administration: an Admin API to manage members, invitations, projects and API keys, plus audit logs. The console also supports project-level member management, budgets, rate limits and IP whitelists. Permission controls attach to projects rather than fine-grained roles or per-key scopes, the Admin API is beta, and nothing covers data policies such as retention or training opt-out. Missing for 10: data-policy controls (retention/training/data governance), documented role-based permission granularity, workspace admin for the kimi.com assistant itself, GA (non-beta) admin API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can manage members, permissions, and data policies for my organization's workspace

citations.quote: The Kimi Admin API lets organization administrators manage members, invitations, projects, and inference API keys programmatically, and query billing, usage, and audit logs
set project budgets and rate limits, manage members, configure an IP whitelist, and review organization and project consumption
